profile.headline: Educator and Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a software engineer as well as a scientist and teacher. I have strong math, programming, and problem-solving skills from my work as a PhD physicist. I have educational expertise from my Master's work and teaching experience. I have programmed extensive and scalable server-side applications at EarthLink and other large companies, and more specific work in educational technology from my work at Teachscape and Kidaptive.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing educational applications based on an adaptive learning platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing software for use in teacher evaluation and training.

positions.title: Technical Content Coordinator
positions.description: Working as technical expert and pedagogic expert in creation of free, open-source lessons for the educational non-profit CK-12 Foundation.

positions.title: Teacher
positions.description: Taught integrated science and chemistry for five sections, full-time.

positions.title: Technical Yahoo
positions.description: Software developer creating internal tools for analyzing and maintaining the Yahoo network.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Software developer primarily in Java, creating web services running on Linux servers including voice-over-ip support, mobile devices, and interactive television.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech lead in designing systems for Voice-over-IP services. Tested and evaluated commercial vendors for features, drafted the core infrastructure architecture document, and lead implementation of features for the Java-based EarthLink voice portal (cf. myvoice.earthlink.net ). Also, adapted open-source package (the SIP Express Router) for a prototype free service using C and C++.

positions.title: Advanced Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented the interactive website for Excite Mobile using JSP and Java servlets. This was a website for ordinary desktop browsers where the user edits their account and preferences for their Excite wireless portal for Palm and cellphones. Also designed and implemented internal tools including a web-based editor for mobile content and a secure interactive calendar of cable outages.

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked with children with reading issues for one-on-one interaction listening, reading, and writing.
